title: Project-level ledger (context/project/state.yaml)
description: The workspace ledger tracking each plan's implementation status. This is the entry point that resume/orchestration reads to find the unfinished plan. Mutable; the source of truth for automation (change-doc front-matter stays human-readable narrative).

status.description: Whole-plan implementation status across the workspace.

project_change.description: The PROJECT-CHANGE <NNN> this plan implements, or null for a full/greenfield plan.
